title: Video projects with a Library and Gemini, generation tabs, Upscale this, Nano Banana 2.1, Montserrat — and a reliability pass
notes:
- Video Library: the video drawer has a Tune / Library switch like Image — this project's takes, every take from every project, and your image renders; click a take to watch it, drag it onto the motion reference, the video to edit or extend, a keyframe or the references
- The Gemini prompt assistant works in Video too: it writes timecoded Seedance prompts for your setup (clay, references, duration, ratio, audio), sees your clay as a sheet of frames, never repeats the reference sentences the app adds itself, and fills the prompt field — one thread per video project
- Shots slider: the shots strip scrolls with arrows, the mouse wheel and a scrub bar, and slides to the newest take
- Every new project — image or video, blank or from files — opens under the purple frame
- Montserrat is the app font everywhere (the AI Portal logo keeps its own face)
- Video projects: Video opens on your video projects, like Image — start one blank, in a mode (reference, frames, edit, extend) or by dropping a clip or stills; each project keeps its prompt, inputs, settings and shots, saves itself as you work, and its card shows a frame of the latest shot
- Video takes belong to their project: switch projects or leave Video while a take renders and it lands in its own project (bell note), its card breathes meanwhile, and closing the app no longer loses a take — it is picked up again on the next start (BytePlus keeps results for 24 h). Your earlier shots moved into a project called “Earlier video shots”
- Video workspace: a back arrow to your video projects next to Home (both save first); clips and stills can be dropped straight onto the workspace
- Home: News and Continue labels in dark purple, the greeting glows softly, project card glows fade in and out, the top-bar buttons glow behind themselves, and the project list fades under the Continue card only once you scroll; the bell and update dots show without hovering
- Fix: the Gemini assistant no longer dies with "ConnectionError" on long chats — only the last two image turns travel with each message (older pictures stay referenced by name), the request stays under 9 MB and a failed send is retried once; this also stops paying for every attached picture again on every turn
- Fix: MAX briefs get 150 s instead of 60 (Gemini 3.1 Pro often needs 60-90 s on a long brief); if a brief still fails you are told the render used your raw prompt
- NanoBanana: a slot that fails before anything was billed (busy API, 503, connection) is retried once; the reason of every failed image is shown and kept in the trace; a possibly billed failure is listed apart in the costs
- Nano Banana 2.1 is in the engine list (new, cheaper); Nano Banana 2 is marked deprecated by Google
- Generation tabs: "+" next to Generation opens another independent generation view in the same project — each tab keeps its own batch and its own running job; the Edits and Upscales tabs never show another tab's loading screen
- Projects are independent too: opening another project while one is generating no longer shows that loading screen — the run keeps going in its own project and tab, lands there (bell note), and coming back shows it still running with its elapsed time
- Generation view: the batch's images sit on the left strip (like Edits), with Compare — the file-name caption and the centre slot buttons are gone
- Upscale this: an Upscale button on the output bar — NanoBanana Pro by default, or AIP Upscaler (local, free), Magnific, GPT Image, at 2K / 4K / 8K; the result lands in a new Upscales tab with Compare
- Region editing: pick the engine in the region panel (NB Pro, GPT Image or Seedream 5) whatever the top bar holds; a freehand zone shows only its shape — no rectangle, no spinner; a box drawn in the top-right corner no longer blocks the instruction field
- Drag the picture in the viewer (or a thumbnail from the batch strip) onto the inputs rail to reuse it — it lands in the cutout slot straight away
- A project with a generation running inside breathes on the home and welcome screens (purple glow + "generating" chip); the shutter timer shows only on the tab that is generating — on other tabs it takes you there
- The Edits and Upscales tabs can be closed; they come back with the next edit or upscale. NanoBanana runs up to 8 parallel slots
- Recent prompts show the last render made with each prompt; the ambience icon stops dancing at volume zero; the welcome list fades softly under the Continue card; the viewer's shadow is softer; the home labels are a size up, in purple; the top bar no longer dims in region mode
- Moodboard: Pinterest drops fetch the full-size original (largest rendition, then /originals/), and cards render at full resolution when zoomed in — no more pixelated thumbnails
- Projects name themselves from the brief's SUBJECT line instead of "Untitled project"
- Ctrl+Enter generates; one price everywhere (the parallel pill showed different numbers); the generating tooltip shows the times of your own last runs
- Gone: the deprecated silhouette mask, the "ComfyUI (soon)" region approach, the "HDR Expand · soon" row; shortcuts read Ctrl on Windows; usage-data sharing stays off until you tick it
- Reliability: nothing loads from the internet at start any more (an offline start was a blank window); the backend writes AIPortal/logs/backend.log and is restarted once if it stops; traces live in AIPortal/traces and survive updates (1000 kept); the edit history is really saved with the project now (it was dropped since 3.31.0); the oldest project is archived instead of deleted at the recents cap
